seo.title: Macro Easy — Macro & Nutrition Tracking
seo.description: Macro Easy keeps nutrition tracking lightweight: quick daily entry, home dashboard, and target progress for your nutrition goals without complicated workflows.

hero.label: Simple Macro Tracking
hero.title: Log protein, carbs, and fat in seconds.
text: Macro Easy keeps nutrition tracking lightweight: quick daily entry, home dashboard, and target progress for your nutrition goals without complicated workflows.

items.title: Fast daily logging
items.text: Capture protein, carbs, and fat with minimal taps and a no-friction entry flow.

items.title: Goal-focused dashboard
items.text: See progress to your macro targets and stay informed without opening a bulky nutrition editor.

items.title: Favorites and history
items.text: Reuse recent meals and repeat entries quickly, especially useful when nutrition is repetitive.

items.title: Health integration
items.text: Optional Health app sync keeps your nutrition data available with Apple Health workflows.

items.title: Offline-first design
items.text: All calculations happen on device, so your nutrition habits are never blocked by network issues.

sections.title: Privacy
text: Macro Easy stores your entries and targets locally. No ad SDKs, no tracking frameworks, and no accounts are used to consume data from this app.

cta.title: Ready to start?
cta.text: Install Macro Easy to track smarter and stay focused on what matters.
